translations.translatedText: There is a lot of snow clearing this winter. The human rights organisation Amnesty criticises Finland. Estonians celebrate 100-year-old Estonia. The snowy winter also gives children in Helsinki a chance to move more. The weather forecast promises cold and sunny weather.
